description: This file defines a GTK dialog class for adding new storage devices or partitions, including support for various device types, filesystems, RAID levels, encryption, and advanced options. It is part of a GUI application for disk management.

classes.name: AdvancedOptions
classes.description: Class for managing advanced options UI components in the add device dialog.

classes.name: AddDialog
classes.description: Main class implementing the GTK dialog for adding new storage devices or partitions with various configurations.

methods.name: AdvancedOptions.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the advanced options UI component based on device type.

methods.name: AdvancedOptions.lvm_options
methods.description: Creates UI for LVM PE size selection.

methods.name: AdvancedOptions.partition_options
methods.description: Creates UI for partition type selection.

methods.name: AdvancedOptions.mdraid_options
methods.description: Creates UI for MD RAID chunk size selection.

methods.name: AdvancedOptions.on_pesize_changed
methods.description: Callback for when PE size selection changes, updates size limits.

methods.name: AdvancedOptions.on_partition_type_changed
methods.description: Callback for when partition type changes, shows/hides relevant widgets.

methods.name: AdvancedOptions.destroy
methods.description: Destroys the advanced options UI components.

methods.name: AdvancedOptions.show
methods.description: Shows the advanced options UI components.

methods.name: AdvancedOptions.hide
methods.description: Hides the advanced options UI components.

methods.name: AdvancedOptions.set_sensitive
methods.description: Sets sensitivity (enabled/disabled) for all advanced options widgets.

methods.name: AdvancedOptions.validate_user_input
methods.description: Validates user input for advanced options, e.g., chunk size.

methods.name: AdvancedOptions.get_selection
methods.description: Returns the current selection of advanced options.

methods.name: AddDialog.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the add device dialog, sets up UI components and event handlers.

methods.name: AddDialog.scrolled_adjust
methods.description: Adjusts the size of the scrollable area based on content size.

methods.name: _available_add_types
methods.description: Determines available device types for addition based on parent device and free space.

methods.name: AddDialog.add_device_chooser
methods.description: Creates UI for selecting device type to add.

methods.name: AddDialog.add_parent_list
methods.description: Creates UI for selecting parent devices for the new device.

methods.name: AddDialog.update_raid_type_chooser
methods.description: Updates RAID level options based on current selection.

methods.name: AddDialog.select_selected_free_region
methods.description: Selects the free region in the parent list that matches user selection.

methods.name: AddDialog.update_parent_list
methods.description: Updates the list of parent devices based on current device type.

methods.name: AddDialog.on_cell_toggled
methods.description: Handles toggling of parent device selection checkboxes.

methods.name: AddDialog.raid_member_max_size
methods.description: Calculates maximum size for RAID member devices.

methods.name: AddDialog.update_size_area_limits
methods.description: Updates size limits for the size selection UI component.

methods.name: AddDialog._get_parent_min_size
methods.description: Returns minimal size for parent devices based on device type.

methods.name: AddDialog._get_parent_max_size
methods.description: Returns maximum size for parent devices based on device type.

methods.name: AddDialog._get_parents
methods.description: Returns list of selected parent devices for new device.

methods.name: AddDialog._get_min_size_limit
methods.description: Calculates minimal size limit for new device.

methods.name: AddDialog._get_max_size_limit
methods.description: Calculates maximum size limit for new device.

methods.name: AddDialog.add_size_area
methods.description: Creates or updates the size selection UI component.

methods.name: AddDialog.add_md_type_chooser
methods.description: Creates UI for MD array type selection.

methods.name: AddDialog.on_md_type_changed
methods.description: Handles change in MD array type selection.

methods.name: AddDialog.add_fs_chooser
methods.description: Creates UI for filesystem selection.

methods.name: AddDialog._allow_format_size
methods.description: Checks if a filesystem can be formatted on the selected free space.

methods.name: AddDialog.update_fs_chooser
methods.description: Updates the filesystem options based on size constraints.

methods.name: AddDialog.on_filesystems_combo_changed

methods.name: AddDialog.add_name_chooser

methods.name: AddDialog.add_mountpoint
methods.description: Creates UI for mountpoint input.

methods.name: AddDialog.add_advanced_options
methods.description: Creates or destroys advanced options UI based on device type.

methods.name: AddDialog.show_widgets
methods.description: Shows specified UI widgets.

methods.name: AddDialog.hide_widgets
methods.description: Hides specified UI widgets.

methods.description: Handles toggling of encryption options.

methods.name: AddDialog.update_encryption_chooser
